mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ai_llm_model WHERE model_type = #{modelType} AND is_default = true AND enabled = true LIMIT 1

update.foreach: UPDATE ai_llm_model SET total_calls = total_calls + #{item.callCount}, total_tokens = total_tokens + #{item.tokenCount}, total_cost = total_cost + #{item.cost}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{item.modelId}

mapper.select: SELECT provider, model_type, COUNT(*) as count FROM ai_llm_model WHERE enabled = true GROUP BY provider, model_type
